text:
---
name: fix-mse-cards
description: Reconcile direct MSE edits into YGO-x-MTG. Use for edited MSE card/set files, MSE update validation, or /skill:fix-mse-cards. Preserve MSE intent, resolve conflicts through HTML reviews, route rule decisions through update-rules, then sync docs/scripts/tests/assets.
compatibility: YGO-x-MTG repo; Python 3; configured Magic Set Editor for export validation.
metadata:
  project: YGO-x-MTG
disable-model-invocation: true
---

# Fix MSE Cards

MSE edits = provisional source. Preserve unless review marks user error.

## Non-negotiable flow

1. Scope dirty MSE files.
2. Analyze diffs vs rules.
3. Resolve semantic/card conflicts in one `.tmp/*.html`; stop.
4. Reconcile MSE + consumers.
5. Resolve all rule proposals in one `.tmp/*.html`; stop.
6. Call `update-rules`; apply decisions; write final ADR.
7. Verify lint/tests/export.

No decision questions in chat. No `AskUserQuestion`. Every question/proposal series → HTML. Final ADR may use Markdown: resolved record, no questions.

## HTML review contract

Path:

```text
.tmp/fix-mse-cards/YYYY-MM-DD-<project-slug>-card-conflicts.html
.tmp/fix-mse-cards/YYYY-MM-DD-<project-slug>-rule-proposals.html
```

One file per gate/run. Self-contained HTML5: UTF-8, viewport, semantic markup, inline CSS/JS, no remote deps. Dark default; `prefers-color-scheme` light support. Responsive + printable. High readability: sticky summary/nav, progress, grouped decision cards, evidence tables, before/after diffs, concrete examples, impact badges. Use inline SVG/CSS diagrams only when relationships benefit; no decorative charts. WCAG AA contrast; keyboard focus; labels for controls.

Source must stay machine-readable after user edits:

```html
<body data-status="AWAITING_USER" data-review-id="...">
  <article id="C1" data-kind="card-conflict">
    <dd data-field="decision">TODO</dd>
    <dd data-field="final-wording"></dd>
    <dd data-field="notes"></dd>
  </article>
</body>
```

Rule IDs use `D*`/`R*`. Visible instructions: replace `TODO`, fill required text, change `data-status` to `READY`, save, say `continue`. Optional JS may aid filtering/progress; source values remain authority. Never rely only on browser state/localStorage.

Name collisions → append `-2`, `-3`, … Never overwrite unfinished/completed review.

## Repo contracts

- Mutable source: `cards_mse/00_drafts/*/*.mse-set/`; folder, not zip.
- Frozen: `02_alpha`, `04_beta`, `06_released`, generated aggregates. Never edit. Never create draft PDFs.
- Manifest: `<project>.mse-set/set`; cards: `card <slug>` via `include_file:`.
- General rules: `docs/rules/*`, `docs/keywords/*`, `docs/design/*`; indexes: `docs/RULES.md`, `docs/KEYWORDS.md`.
- Archetype rules: numbered `CONTEXT.md`/`DESIGN.md`/`RULES.md`/`KEYWORDS.md`. Card values stay MSE-only.
- Generators: `.script/`; prevent stale regeneration.
- MSE config: gitignored `.env` via `launcher/mse_config.py`; never hardcode install path.
- Source art: `original_images/<card_type>/`; imported MSE art: project `mse_images/`.
- Preserve unrelated work. No reset/checkout/full-project regeneration. No backup/export/cache inside active `.mse-set`.

## Phase 0 — Scope

Run:

```bash
git status --short
git diff --name-status -- cards_mse
git diff -- cards_mse
```

Use user paths; else dirty/untracked mutable MSE paths. Classify manifest/card/art/generated files. Record exact scope + pre-edit diff. Read changed text fully with `utf-8-sig` semantics. Preserve BOM need. No direct MSE save identified → stop.

## Phase 1 — Analyze

Extract without rewrite: project/include, name, cost, frame/stylesheet, type/subtype, invocation/material, rules/labels, P/T, rarity/code, image refs, card add/remove/rename, new vocabulary/keyword/timing/zone/Summon rule.

Check:

- include target exists; each card included once;
- image ref resolves in project;
- removals leave no card/art orphan;
- card/code totals match;
- filenames/names match conventions.

Facts only. No memory-based correction.

## Phase 2 — Compare

Read fully: relevant `docs/rules/*`, `docs/keywords/*`, index links, numbered project docs, 2–3 sibling cards, named generators, affected tests.

Compare mechanics, timing, labels, Summon/material syntax, zones, vocabulary, type/frame, cost/stat conversion, English/PSCT, MSE structure, consumer assumptions.

Create `C1…` ledger. Each item: MSE `path:line`, governing rule `path:line`, semantic delta, affected files, impact, options.

Classification:

- `RESTORE` → user error; restore documented value.
- `ACCEPT` → preserve MSE card/archetype change.
- `REVISE` → use required final wording/context.
- `PATTERN_DESTROYER` flag → accepted syntax contradicts reusable rule.

Card cost/stat/type/effect/archetype exception ≠ general rule. Unambiguous grammar/style → Phase 4. Meaning risk—target, timing, cost, zone, optionality, frequency, resolution—→ ledger.

Normally illegal Summon, esp Sideboard bypass: add conflict item. Choices: `ADD_PERMISSION`, `KEEP_RESTRICTIONS`, `REVISE`. Explain `ignoring the restrictions of Summon` grants legality; does not make proper Summon. Never infer.

## Phase 3 — Card-conflict HTML gate

Ledger empty → continue. Else generate one card-conflicts HTML per contract. Include every `C*`; no chat questions. Stop. Report path + unresolved IDs.

On `continue`, reopen same file. Require `data-status="READY"`; no `TODO`; required `REVISE` text present. Incomplete → report IDs; stop. File answers = authority.

Collect accepted `PATTERN_DESTROYER` items as `D1…`: title, scope, old rule/evidence, conflict evidence, reason, exact question, impacted files, smallest reusable proposal, side effects.

## Phase 4 — Reconcile

Apply approved `RESTORE`/`REVISE` changes. Preserve accepted MSE meaning. Apply mechanical English, punctuation, capitalization, markup, labels, indentation, counts, refs. Any possible mechanic delta → new `C*`; return Phase 3.

Sync consumers:

- reusable archetype identity/mechanics/exceptions only; never duplicate card values/text;
- manifest/include order, numbering/totals;
- generators/updaters/batch lists/fixtures;
- tests/indexes/xrefs;
- source/imported art only when added/replaced/proven orphaned.

Never edit general rule docs here. Search stale values/names globally.

## Phase 5 — Mine rules

From reconciled cards + siblings, collect undocumented reusable patterns as `R1…`: new keyword/event, evolved global rule, repeated PSCT, frame/type/material mapping, grammar/zone convention.

Exclude one-card mechanics, typos, documented rules, incomplete-card accidents.

Each `R*`: evidence `path:line`, current rule, exact proposed wording, scope/boundary/exceptions, impacted files, side effects.

## Phase 6 — Rule-proposals HTML gate

No `D*`/`R*` → report `No general rule proposals.`; skip to Phase 7.

Else generate one rule-proposals HTML per contract containing every item. Decisions: `ACCEPT`, `REJECT`, `REVISE`; `REVISE` requires final wording. Stop. Report path + counts/IDs.

On `continue`, validate same file: `READY`, no `TODO`, complete revisions, current evidence not stale. Stale → set `NEEDS_REVISION`; explain; stop.

Call:

```text
Skill(skill="update-rules", args="review_file=.tmp/fix-mse-cards/<file>.html normalize=false apply_ready=true source=fix-mse-cards")
```

`update-rules` applies accepted/revised rules, preserves rejected rules, writes one final ADR under `docs/ADR/accepted/` containing every accepted/revised/rejected `D*`/`R*`, updates ADR index, marks review `APPLIED`. Resume only after this result. Rescan MSE vs final rules; new conflict → Phase 3.

## Phase 7 — Verify

Run applicable checks:

1. `python .script/lint_mse_card_style.py`;
2. includes/cards/images/totals validation;
3. relevant repo tests;
4. Python compile for changed scripts;
5. `git diff --check`;
6. stale name/rule search;
7. temp export outside `.mse-set` using `MSE_CLI` from `.env` via `MSEConfig`;
8. expected PNG count; delete temp export/cache.

Missing/invalid `.env` → tell user `python launcher/setup_mse.py`. Never guess MSE path. CLI export ≠ GUI Save compatibility; report manual Save/Save As when untested.

## Final report

Report source MSE paths; card decisions; both HTML paths or skipped gates; final ADR path; accepted/revised/rejected rule IDs; mechanic-preserving fixes; synced docs/scripts/tests/assets; lint/test/export results; manual GUI check.

## Never

Overwrite hand edits; decide in chat; split gate docs; proceed with unresolved HTML; apply disputed rules; omit rejected rules from final ADR; mix card facts into global rules; hide semantic change as grammar; leave stale generators/tests/refs/assets; write temp files inside `.mse-set`; commit `.env`/MSE paths/temp exports.

text:
---
name: update-rules
description: Review reusable card-text rule changes through one HTML decision file, apply completed decisions, then record accepted/revised/rejected outcomes in one ADR. Use for wording, grammar, typography, keywords, PSCT, templating, or design-rule changes.
compatibility: YGO-x-MTG repo; optional normalize-card-formatting skill.
metadata:
  project: YGO-x-MTG
---

# Update Rules

Decision channel = HTML file, not chat. Never use `AskUserQuestion`. Generate once; stop; resume on `continue`; apply without second approval.

## Inputs

- Rule text/evidence/request, or `review_file=<path>`.
- `normalize=true|false`; default `false`.
- `apply_ready=true` for caller-supplied completed review.
- Bare `continue` resumes file created earlier in same conversation.

Legacy `docs/ADR/proposed/*.md` input remains readable for unfinished work. Never generate new Markdown question/proposal docs.

## Ownership

- Syntax/PSCT/formatting → `docs/rules/TEMPLATING.md`
- Zones → `docs/rules/ZONES.md`
- Types/Trap/face-down → `docs/rules/CARD_TYPES.md`
- Summon legality/materials → `docs/rules/SUMMONING.md`
- Deck/mulligan/copies → `docs/rules/DECK_BUILDING.md`
- Keyword → matching `docs/keywords/*`
- Frame/design → matching `docs/design/*`
- Archetype-only → numbered archetype module
- Card-specific → MSE only

`docs/RULES.md`/`docs/KEYWORDS.md` = indexes. One detailed owner; no duplicates.

## Eligible items

Only:

- `D*` pattern destroyer: syntax/templating contradicts established reusable rule.
- `R*` pattern maker: undocumented reusable convention—new keyword/event, repeated PSCT, stable process, generalization.

Prefer 2+ maker examples. One allowed for explicit keyword/obvious reusable boundary.

Exclude balance/cost/color/stats/rarity/frame/art; one-card mechanic; archetype fact; typo/unambiguous cleanup; already-documented rule.

## Phase 1 — Analyze

Read `docs/rules/TEMPLATING.md`; follow relevant `docs/RULES.md`/`docs/KEYWORDS.md` links; read affected archetype docs, MSE cards, generators, tests. Search established + proposed forms. Record exact `path:line` evidence + impacted cards.

No `D*`/`R*` → report no general rule review; route local/mechanical work to owner; stop.

## Phase 2 — Create HTML gate

Caller supplied complete HTML → reuse; never duplicate/re-derive.

Else write:

```text
.tmp/update-rules/YYYY-MM-DD-<scope-slug>-rule-proposals.html
```

Collision → `-2`, `-3`, … Never overwrite review.

```html
<body data-status="AWAITING_USER" data-review-id="YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>"
      data-normalize="false">
  <article id="D1" data-kind="pattern-destroyer">
    <dd data-field="decision">TODO</dd>
    <dd data-field="final-wording"></dd>
    <dd data-field="notes"></dd>
  </article>
</body>
```

Each `R*`: scope, evidence, current rule, ruling question, exact proposal, boundaries/exceptions, impacted files, side effects.

- validation results.

Ask rule questions in chat; use `AskUserQuestion`; generate Markdown question docs; infer decisions; poll; apply partial/TODO review; omit rejected decisions from ADR; put archetype rules in global docs; create items for ordinary card data/cleanup; normalize before READY; duplicate detailed rules.

import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
UPDATE_RULES = ROOT / ".agents/skills/update-rules/SKILL.md"
VALIDATE_MSE = ROOT / ".agents/skills/fix-mse-cards/SKILL.md"
CONTEXT = ROOT / "docs/CONTEXT.md"
RULES = ROOT / "docs/rules/TEMPLATING.md"
SHADDOLL = ROOT / "docs/02_shaddoll/RULES.md"


class UpdateRulesSkillTest(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls) -> None:
        cls.skill = UPDATE_RULES.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
        cls.validate_skill = VALIDATE_MSE.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
        cls.context = CONTEXT.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
        cls.rules = RULES.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
        cls.shaddoll = SHADDOLL.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")

    def test_rule_skill_uses_html_review_gate_instead_of_chat_questions(self) -> None:
        self.assertIn(".tmp/update-rules/YYYY-MM-DD-<scope-slug>-rule-proposals.html", self.skill)
        self.assertIn('data-status="AWAITING_USER"', self.skill)
        self.assertIn('data-status="READY"', self.skill)
        self.assertIn("pattern-destroyer", self.skill)
        self.assertIn("pattern maker", self.skill)
        self.assertIn("Never use `AskUserQuestion`", self.skill)
        self.assertIn("Never generate new Markdown question/proposal docs", self.skill)

    def test_continue_resumes_html_review_without_another_interview(self) -> None:
        self.assertIn("## Phase 3 — Resume/validate", self.skill)
        self.assertIn("same-conversation path", self.skill)
        self.assertIn("Zero/multiple", self.skill)
        self.assertIn("File answers = authority", self.skill)
        self.assertIn("No polling", self.skill)

    def test_completed_rule_set_becomes_accepted_adr(self) -> None:
        self.assertIn("docs/ADR/accepted/NNNN-<scope-slug>.md", self.skill)
        self.assertIn("Rejected rules must remain in ADR", self.skill)
        self.assertIn("Update `docs/ADR/README.md` Accepted index", self.skill)
        self.assertIn("Never create new `docs/ADR/proposed/*` review", self.skill)

    def test_only_pattern_destroyers_and_makers_create_rule_items(self) -> None:
        self.assertIn("`D*` pattern destroyer", self.skill)
        self.assertIn("`R*` pattern maker", self.skill)
        self.assertIn("one-card mechanic", self.skill)
        self.assertIn("already-documented rule", self.skill)

    def test_general_and_archetype_rules_have_separate_owners(self) -> None:
        self.assertIn("Change ownership", self.context)
        self.assertIn("Archetype documentation", self.context)
        self.assertNotIn("Shaddoll creatures retain", self.context)
        self.assertIn("## Naming", self.shaddoll)
        self.assertIn("Do not standardize race as Puppet", self.shaddoll)
        self.assertIn("Card-specific value", self.context)
        self.assertIn("MSE only", self.context)

    def test_psct_order_is_documented(self) -> None:
        self.assertIn("PSCT", self.rules)
        self.assertIn("**condition keyword** —", self.rules)
        self.assertIn("costs and targets;", self.rules)
        self.assertIn("Targeting is activation action, never cost", self.rules)

    def test_validate_mse_uses_html_gates_and_waits_for_completion(self) -> None:
        self.assertIn("card-conflicts.html", self.validate_skill)
        self.assertIn("rule-proposals.html", self.validate_skill)
        self.assertIn('data-status="READY"', self.validate_skill)
        self.assertIn("marks review `APPLIED`", self.validate_skill)
        self.assertIn("preserve MSE card/archetype change", self.validate_skill)
        self.assertIn("say `continue`", self.validate_skill)
        self.assertIn("No `AskUserQuestion`", self.validate_skill)
        self.assertIn("final ADR", self.validate_skill)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

    10	# Fix MSE Cards
    11	
    12	MSE edits = provisional source. Preserve unless review marks user error.
    13	
    14	## Non-negotiable flow
    15	
    16	1. Scope dirty MSE files.
    17	2. Analyze diffs vs rules.
    18	3. Resolve semantic/card conflicts in one `.tmp/*.html`; stop.
    19	4. Reconcile MSE + consumers.
    20	5. Resolve all rule proposals in one `.tmp/*.html`; stop.

    22	7. Verify lint/tests/export.
    23	
    24	No decision questions in chat. No `AskUserQuestion`. Every question/proposal series → HTML. Final ADR may use Markdown: resolved record, no questions.
    25	
    26	## HTML review contract
    27	
    28	Path:
    29	
    30	```text
    31	.tmp/fix-mse-cards/YYYY-MM-DD-<project-slug>-card-conflicts.html
    32	.tmp/fix-mse-cards/YYYY-MM-DD-<project-slug>-rule-proposals.html
    33	```
    34	
    35	One file per gate/run. Self-contained HTML5: UTF-8, viewport, semantic markup, inline CSS/JS, no remote deps. Dark default; `prefers-color-scheme` light support. Responsive + printable. High readability: sticky summary/nav, progress, grouped decision cards, evidence tables, before/after diffs, concrete examples, impact badges. Use inline SVG/CSS diagrams only when relationships benefit; no decorative charts. WCAG AA contrast; keyboard focus; labels for controls.
    36	
    37	Source must stay machine-readable after user edits:
    38	
    39	```html
    40	<body data-status="AWAITING_USER" data-review-id="...">
    41	  <article id="C1" data-kind="card-conflict">
    42	    <dd data-field="decision">TODO</dd>
    43	    <dd data-field="final-wording"></dd>
    44	    <dd data-field="notes"></dd>
    45	  </article>
    46	</body>
    47	```
    48	
    49	Rule IDs use `D*`/`R*`. Visible instructions: replace `TODO`, fill required text, change `data-status` to `READY`, save, say `continue`. Optional JS may aid filtering/progress; source values remain authority. Never rely only on browser state/localStorage.
    50	
    51	Name collisions → append `-2`, `-3`, … Never overwrite unfinished/completed review.
    52	
    53	## Repo contracts
    54	
    55	- Mutable source: `cards_mse/00_drafts/*/*.mse-set/`; folder, not zip.
    56	- Frozen: `02_alpha`, `04_beta`, `06_released`, generated aggregates. Never edit. Never create draft PDFs.
    57	- Manifest: `<project>.mse-set/set`; cards: `card <slug>` via `include_file:`.
    58	- General rules: `docs/rules/*`, `docs/keywords/*`, `docs/design/*`; indexes: `docs/RULES.md`, `docs/KEYWORDS.md`.
    59	- Archetype rules: numbered `CONTEXT.md`/`DESIGN.md`/`RULES.md`/`KEYWORDS.md`. Card values stay MSE-only.
    60	- Generators: `.script/`; prevent stale regeneration.
    61	- MSE config: gitignored `.env` via `launcher/mse_config.py`; never hardcode install path.
    62	- Source art: `original_images/<card_type>/`; imported MSE art: project `mse_images/`.
    63	- Preserve unrelated work. No reset/checkout/full-project regeneration. No backup/export/cache inside active `.mse-set`.
    64

    66	
    67	Run:
    68	
    69	```bash
    70	git status --short
    71	git diff --name-status -- cards_mse
    72	git diff -- cards_mse
    73	```
    74

    76	
    77	## Phase 1 — Analyze
    78	
    79	Extract without rewrite: project/include, name, cost, frame/stylesheet, type/subtype, invocation/material, rules/labels, P/T, rarity/code, image refs, card add/remove/rename, new vocabulary/keyword/timing/zone/Summon rule.

    87	- filenames/names match conventions.
    88	
    89	Facts only. No memory-based correction.
    90	
    91	## Phase 2 — Compare
    92	
    93	Read fully: relevant `docs/rules/*`, `docs/keywords/*`, index links, numbered project docs, 2–3 sibling cards, named generators, affected tests.
    94	
    95	Compare mechanics, timing, labels, Summon/material syntax, zones, vocabulary, type/frame, cost/stat conversion, English/PSCT, MSE structure, consumer assumptions.

   100

   102	- `ACCEPT` → preserve MSE card/archetype change.
   103	- `REVISE` → use required final wording/context.
   104	- `PATTERN_DESTROYER` flag → accepted syntax contradicts reusable rule.

   106	Card cost/stat/type/effect/archetype exception ≠ general rule. Unambiguous grammar/style → Phase 4. Meaning risk—target, timing, cost, zone, optionality, frequency, resolution—→ ledger.
   107

   111

   113

   115	
   116	Collect accepted `PATTERN_DESTROYER` items as `D1…`: title, scope, old rule/evidence, conflict evidence, reason, exact question, impacted files, smallest reusable proposal, side effects.
   117

   120	Apply approved `RESTORE`/`REVISE` changes. Preserve accepted MSE meaning. Apply mechanical English, punctuation, capitalization, markup, labels, indentation, counts, refs. Any possible mechanic delta → new `C*`; return Phase 3.
   121	
   122	Sync consumers:
   123	
   124	- reusable archetype identity/mechanics/exceptions only; never duplicate card values/text;
   125	- manifest/include order, numbering/totals;
   126	- generators/updaters/batch lists/fixtures;
   127	- tests/indexes/xrefs;
   128	- source/imported art only when added/replaced/proven orphaned.
   129	
   130	Never edit general rule docs here. Search stale values/names globally.
   131	
   132	## Phase 5 — Mine rules
   133	
   134	From reconciled cards + siblings, collect undocumented reusable patterns as `R1…`: new keyword/event, evolved global rule, repeated PSCT, frame/type/material mapping, grammar/zone convention.
   135	
   136	Exclude one-card mechanics, typos, documented rules, incomplete-card accidents.
   137	
   138	Each `R*`: evidence `path:line`, current rule, exact proposed wording, scope/boundary/exceptions, impacted files, side effects.
   139	
   140	## Phase 6 — Rule-proposals HTML gate
   141	
   142	No `D*`/`R*` → report `No general rule proposals.`; skip to Phase 7.
   143	
   144	Else generate one rule-proposals HTML per contract containing every item. Decisions: `ACCEPT`, `REJECT`, `REVISE`; `REVISE` requires final wording. Stop. Report path + counts/IDs.
   145	
   146	On `continue`, validate same file: `READY`, no `TODO`, complete revisions, current evidence not stale. Stale → set `NEEDS_REVISION`; explain; stop.
   147	
   148	Call:
   149	
   150	```text
   151	Skill(skill="update-rules", args="review_file=.tmp/fix-mse-cards/<file>.html normalize=false apply_ready=true source=fix-mse-cards")
   152	```
   153	
   154	`update-rules` applies accepted/revised rules, preserves rejected rules, writes one final ADR under `docs/ADR/accepted/` containing every accepted/revised/rejected `D*`/`R*`, updates ADR index, marks review `APPLIED`. Resume only after this result. Rescan MSE vs final rules; new conflict → Phase 3.
   155	
   156	## Phase 7 — Verify
   157	
   158	Run applicable checks:
   159	
   160	1. `python .script/lint_mse_card_style.py`;
   161	2. includes/cards/images/totals validation;
   162	3. relevant repo tests;
   163	4. Python compile for changed scripts;
   164	5. `git diff --check`;
   165	6. stale name/rule search;
   166	7. temp export outside `.mse-set` using `MSE_CLI` from `.env` via `MSEConfig`;
   167	8. expected PNG count; delete temp export/cache.
   168	
   169	Missing/invalid `.env` → tell user `python launcher/setup_mse.py`. Never guess MSE path. CLI export ≠ GUI Save compatibility; report manual Save/Save As when untested.
   170	
   171	## Final report
   172	
   173	Report source MSE paths; card decisions; both HTML paths or skipped gates; final ADR path; accepted/revised/rejected rule IDs; mechanic-preserving fixes; synced docs/scripts/tests/assets; lint/test/export results; manual GUI check.
   174	
   175	## Never
   176	
   177	Overwrite hand edits; decide in chat; split gate docs; proceed with unresolved HTML; apply disputed rules; omit rejected rules from final ADR; mix card facts into global rules; hide semantic change as grammar; leave stale generators/tests/refs/assets; write temp files inside `.mse-set`; commit `.env`/MSE paths/temp exports.

   115

   118	## Phase 4 — Reconcile
   119	
   120	Apply approved `RESTORE`/`REVISE` changes. Preserve accepted MSE meaning. Apply mechanical English, punctuation, capitalization, markup, labels, indentation, counts, refs. Any possible mechanic delta → new `C*`; return Phase 3.

   122	Sync consumers:
   123	
   124	- reusable archetype identity/mechanics/exceptions only; never duplicate card values/text;

   145	
   146	On `continue`, validate same file: `READY`, no `TODO`, complete revisions, current evidence not stale. Stale → set `NEEDS_REVISION`; explain; stop.

Resume only after this result. Rescan MSE vs final rules; new conflict → Phase 3.

text: # Rule review — 12_YGO_Necroz MSE reconciliation - Status: AWAITING_USER - Review ID: 2026-07-17-12-ygo-necroz-rule-proposals - Generated: 2026-07-17 - Normalize after approval: false - Source request: fix-mse-cards — cards_mse/00_drafts/03_nekroz/03_YGO_Nekroz.mse-set ## How to complete this review Answer directly in this Markdown file. For every item, replace `TODO` with exactly one decision: - `ACCEPT` — apply the proposed rule; - `REJECT` — keep the current rule; - `REVISE` — use the text in `Final wording`. # Rule review — 01_YGO_Legend_of_Alpha MSE reconciliation

- Status: AWAITING_USER
- Review ID: 2026-08-01-01-ygo-legend-of-alpha-rule-proposals
- Generated: 2026-08-01
- Normalize after approval: false
- Source request: fix-mse-cards — cards_mse/01_pre_alpha/01_legend_of_alpha/01_YGO_Legend_of_Alpha.mse-set

## How to complete this review

Answer directly in this Markdown file. For every item, replace `TODO` with exactly one decision:

- `ACCEPT` — apply the proposed rule;
- `REJECT` — keep the current rule;
- `REVISE` — use the text in `Final wording`.

For `REVISE`, write the replacement rule under `Final wording`. Use `Notes` for rationale or implementation constraints. Do not remove IDs, questions, or evidence. Chat replies such as “yes”, “looks good”, or revised prose do not count as decisions once this file exists. When finished, change `Status` to `READY`, save the file, and tell the agent `continue`. In the same conversation, you do not need to repeat the path.

## Ruling contradictions — pattern destroyers

### D1 — Ability-loss effects may set card-specific power/toughness

- Scope: general (`docs/rules/TEMPLATING.md`)
- Existing rule: Ability-loss/stat-reset text always uses `The target Creature loses all its abilities and becomes 0/0 until the end of the turn.` (`docs/rules/TEMPLATING.md:76`).
- Conflicting evidence: Alich sets the target to 0/1 (`cards_mse/01_pre_alpha/01_legend_of_alpha/01_YGO_Legend_of_Alpha.mse-set/card burning abyss - alich:21`); Clausolas already uses the same 0/1 reset (`cards_mse/01_pre_alpha/01_legend_of_alpha/01_YGO_Legend_of_Alpha.mse-set/card nekroz - clausolas:20`).
- Why this destroys a pattern: The documented fixed 0/0 template conflicts with repeated card-specific 0/1 resets.
- Question: Should ability-loss effects permit an explicitly stated power/toughness instead of requiring 0/0?
- Impacted cards/files: Alich, Clausolas, future ability-loss effects, `docs/rules/TEMPLATING.md`.
- Proposed resolution: Replace the fixed value rule with: `Ability-loss/stat-reset effects use the power/toughness stated by the card. Canonical form: The target Creature loses all its abilities and becomes P/T until the end of the turn.`
- Side effects: Preserves 0/1 on Alich and Clausolas; future cards must state the intended value explicitly.
- Decision: TODO
- Final wording:
- Notes:

### D4 — Nested event creates a one-shot delayed trigger

- Scope: general (`docs/rules/TEMPLATING.md`, `docs/keywords/EVENTS.md`)
- Existing rule: Each ability begins with one event keyword followed by an em dash (`docs/rules/TEMPLATING.md:13-24`). `On End Step` is a recurring permanent trigger; `This turn On End Step` is the documented one-shot delayed form (`docs/keywords/EVENTS.md:46-47`).
- Conflicting evidence: Scarm nests `On End Step` after `On Send Grave` (`cards_mse/01_pre_alpha/01_legend_of_alpha/01_YGO_Legend_of_Alpha.mse-set/card burning abyss - scarm:21`).
- Why this destroys a pattern: The nested event introduces a second delayed-trigger syntax and leaves its duration/next-occurrence behavior undocumented.
- Question: Should `Primary Event — Secondary Event, instruction` create a one-shot delayed trigger at the next occurrence of the secondary event?
- Impacted cards/files: Scarm, future delayed triggers, `docs/rules/TEMPLATING.md`, `docs/keywords/EVENTS.md`, keyword/style tests.
- Proposed resolution: Document: `A defined event nested after another event creates a one-shot delayed trigger: Primary Event — Secondary Event, instruction. The instruction occurs at the next applicable Secondary Event, then the delayed trigger expires. A standalone Secondary Event — instruction remains recurring.`
- Side effects: Makes Scarm distinct from a recurring `On End Step` permanent trigger; overlaps with current `This turn On End Step` syntax, which may need narrowing to same-turn delays.
- Decision: TODO
- Final wording:
- Notes:

### D5 — New After Attack or Block event

- Scope: general (`docs/keywords/EVENTS.md`)
- Existing rule: `On Attack or Block` triggers when a Creature attacks or blocks (`docs/keywords/EVENTS.md:13`); no post-combat equivalent exists.
- Conflicting evidence: Downerd Magician uses `After Attack or Block` (`cards_mse/01_pre_alpha/01_legend_of_alpha/01_YGO_Legend_of_Alpha.mse-set/card downerd magician:23`).
- Why this destroys a pattern: New bold event is absent from closed documented event vocabulary; style lint rejects it.
- Question: Should `After Attack or Block` become a distinct event that occurs after combat involving this Creature concludes?
- Impacted cards/files: Downerd Magician, `docs/keywords/EVENTS.md`, keyword catalog/style lint tests.
- Proposed resolution: Add: `After Attack or Block — after combat involving this Creature as an attacker or blocker concludes.` Keep it distinct from declaration-time `On Attack or Block`.
- Side effects: Downerd detaches after combat instead of at attack/block declaration; style lint must recognize the new event.
- Decision: TODO
- Final wording:
- Notes:

### D8 — Extra Deck card types return to Sideboard instead of private zones

- Scope: general (`docs/rules/ZONES.md`, `docs/rules/SUMMONING.md`)
- Existing rule: Sideboard represents Extra Deck (`docs/rules/ZONES.md:10`), but no rule redirects Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Creatures moving to Hand or Deck. `Bounce` currently sends any permanent to its owner’s Hand (`docs/rules/ZONES.md:31`).
- Conflicting evidence: Brionac shuffles its target into the owner’s Deck (`cards_mse/01_pre_alpha/01_legend_of_alpha/01_YGO_Legend_of_Alpha.mse-set/card nekroz - brionac:20`); Calcab can Bounce a Sideboard-origin permanent (`cards_mse/01_pre_alpha/01_legend_of_alpha/01_YGO_Legend_of_Alpha.mse-set/card burning abyss - calcab:21`); Virgil can shuffle one into Deck (`cards_mse/01_pre_alpha/01_legend_of_alpha/01_YGO_Legend_of_Alpha.mse-set/card burning abyss - virgil:20`).
- Why this destroys a pattern: Extra Deck card types should not enter Hand/Deck private zones, but current movement rules allow both destinations.
- Question: Should Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, and Link Creatures always return to their owner’s Sideboard when an effect would move them to Hand or Deck?
- Impacted cards/files: Brionac, Calcab, Virgil, other Hand/Deck movement, `docs/rules/ZONES.md`, `docs/rules/SUMMONING.md`, tests.
- Proposed resolution: Document: `If a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Creature would move to Hand or Deck, return it to its owner’s Sideboard instead. Ritual Creatures are not redirected. Other destination zones are unaffected.` Also document lowercase instruction `shuffle the target into its owner’s Deck` as Deck movement followed by shuffling that Deck.
- Side effects: Brionac’s normal destination remains Deck, but Fusion/Synchro/Xyz/Link targets return to Sideboard; Bounce receives the same replacement. Ritual Creatures may still enter Hand/Deck.
- Decision: TODO
- Final wording:
- Notes:

### D9 — Numbered ability may invoke complete custom keyword without body text

- Scope: general (`docs/rules/TEMPLATING.md`)
- Existing rule: Every ability follows prefix/event/procedure/resolution structure (`docs/rules/TEMPLATING.md:13-24`); bodyless numbered custom-keyword abilities are not documented.
- Conflicting evidence: Cycle, Kaleidoscope, and Mirror print only `(2 - Activated Sorcery Hard) Nekroz Recovery` (`cards_mse/01_pre_alpha/01_legend_of_alpha/01_YGO_Legend_of_Alpha.mse-set/card nekroz - cycle:20`, `card nekroz - kaleidoscope:20`, `card nekroz - mirror:20`). The complete effect exists in `docs/03_nekroz/KEYWORDS.md:3-5`.
- Why this destroys a pattern: These abilities omit the procedure/resolution body required by current universal ability format.
- Question: May a numbered ability consist solely of a documented custom keyword whose definition supplies the complete effect?
- Impacted cards/files: Nekroz Cycle, Kaleidoscope, Mirror, future custom keywords, `docs/rules/TEMPLATING.md`, tests.
- Proposed resolution: Add: `A numbered ability may consist solely of a documented archetype custom keyword when that keyword defines the complete effect. Bodyless base actions and event keywords remain invalid. Cards outside the owning archetype print the full effect.`
- Side effects: Keeps compact `Nekroz Recovery` invocations; keyword definitions become rules-bearing dependencies for card resolution.
- Decision: TODO
- Final wording:
- Notes:

## New possible rules — pattern makers

None.

## Review

### High

- **Legacy Markdown auto-resume broken** — `.agents/skills/update-rules/SKILL.md:20` promises pending `docs/ADR/proposed/*.md` compatibility, but fallback discovery at `.agents/skills/update-rules/SKILL.md:90` scans only HTML. Bare `continue` after lost conversation context cannot discover existing legacy reviews. Include pending legacy Markdown in candidate scan.

- **`ADD_PERMISSION` decision never applied** — `.agents/skills/fix-mse-cards/SKILL.md:108` permits `ADD_PERMISSION`, but reconciliation at `.agents/skills/fix-mse-cards/SKILL.md:120` applies only `RESTORE`/`REVISE`. Review can complete while illegal Summon remains unchanged. Add explicit application step.

### Medium

- **Decision validation accepts invalid tokens** — `.agents/skills/fix-mse-cards/SKILL.md:114` checks only `READY`, absent `TODO`, revised text. `.agents/skills/update-rules/SKILL.md:92` similarly requires items be “decided” without exact enum validation. Typos/wrong decision vocabulary can reach apply phase, while `.agents/skills/update-rules/SKILL.md:98-100` defines no fallback. Validate exact per-item allowlists.

- **Tests permit known workflow regressions** — `tests/test_update_rules_skill.py:21-41` and `tests/test_update_rules_skill.py:64-72` use loose substring checks. No coverage for legacy Markdown fallback, exact decision enums, `ADD_PERMISSION` application, dark/readable/self-contained HTML contract. Current suite passes despite findings above.

### Correct

- HTML-only new decision docs explicitly required, including dark accessible style: `.agents/skills/fix-mse-cards/SKILL.md:24-49`, `.agents/skills/update-rules/SKILL.md:53-86`.
- Final ADR records accepted/revised/rejected outcomes: `.agents/skills/update-rules/SKILL.md:106-124`.
- Updated unit suite passes: 7 tests.
- Diff whitespace validation passes.
